ga_remainder.rule: Target GA region (Target KPI IE, TOTAL RGU GA) minus the DSE GA targets = target of PJP and non-PJP outlets outside the DSE targets (owner, 18 Nov 2026)

rules.sp: Sell-In SP target in pcs per DSE, split IM3 / 3ID; IOH = IM3 + 3ID (rebalanced columns)
rules.osa: OSA target in Rp per DSE, split IM3 / 3ID; IOH = IM3 + 3ID
rules.rebalanced: FINAL REBALANCING: the per-DSE target after redistribution inside the MC; used for productivity and achievement
rules.original: ORIGINAL: uniform per-DSE target before rebalancing (kept for reference, sp0 / osa0)
rules.aggregation: MC, Area and Region targets are sums of DSE targets (equal to the MC / Area targets in the workbook check sheet)
